node.name: Map SD 835 to ClaimPaymentBatch
node.logic: BPR04 drives payment type: CCC (card), ACH, REV (ACH return). REF qualifiers in the CLP loop: 2H transaction ID, 1Z approval code (CCC) or check number (ACH/REV), TN masked card (CCC) or masked bank account (ACH/REV), 8X card type, EY masked routing, EM OpenEdge XWeb GUID, TD reversal. NM1*QC NM109 = patGUID, NM1*IL NM109 = ppGUID.
